Using inclusion-exclusion:

- Sum of multiples of 3 up to 1000:  
  \(3 \cdot \frac{333 \cdot 334}{2} = 166{,}833\)

- Sum of multiples of 5 up to 1000:  
  \(5 \cdot \frac{200 \cdot 201}{2} = 100{,}500\)

- Sum of multiples of 15 up to 1000:  
  \(15 \cdot \frac{66 \cdot 67}{2} = 33{,}165\)

So:

\[
166{,}833 + 100{,}500 - 33{,}165 = 234{,}168
\]
